relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: there was a significant reduction in the number of headache days in the 3 groups when compared with the control ( P < 0.0001)

key_findings: Anti-CGRP mAbs (erenumab, galcanezumab, fremanezumab) reduced headache days vs conventional treatment in chronic migraine with medication overuse headache (open real-world study).
